Invest in primary and secondary prevention. MoH would avert projected

expenditure of up to VT 45,000 ($500) per year in pharmaceutical costs alone for

every person that avoided becoming an insulin-dependent diabetes patient.

Investing in primary and secondary prevention is strategically important. Yet

combined spending on NCD prevention was only VT 1.6 million or 0.6 per cent

of total public health allocation in 2010.

Be strategic about human resources. Personnel costs now absorb more than

two-thirds (67 percent) of the total MOH budget, a higher proportion than at any
